name: Symbol of Despair
body:
School enchantment (compulsion) [despair, emotion, mind-affecting]; Level cleric/oracle 4, lathspell 4, sorcerer/wizard 4, witch 4

CASTING

Casting Time 10 minutes
Components V, S, M (mercury and phosphorous, plus powdered diamond and opal worth a total of 1,000 gp)

EFFECT

Range 0ft.; see text
Effect one symbol
Duration see text
Saving Throw Will negates; Spell Resistance yes

DESCRIPTION

This spell functions as symbol of death, except all creatures within 60 feet of a symbol of despair are struck with the despairing condition. Unlike symbol of death, symbol of despair has no hit point limit; once it is triggered, a symbol of despair remains active for 1 minute per caster level. If a creature leaves the area of the symbol they are no longer subject to its effects.

Symbol of despair can be made permanent with a permanency spell CL 11+ for the cost of 10,000 gp.
